title: A map fixing a set pointwise and differentiable at x fixes its approximate tangent plane at x
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, A ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, x ∈ ℝ^P and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P such that Q is an approximate tangent space of A at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q: dim Q = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(A)} φ dHⁿ → ∫_Q φ dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), Hⁿ = μHE[n]; Simon Ch. 3, 1.4). Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be differentiable at x with f(x) = x and f(y) = y for every y ∈ A. Then Df(x)v = v for every v ∈ Q, where Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x = x → (∀ y ∈ A, f y = y) → ∀ v ∈ Q, fderiv ℝ f x v = v
